questions.stem: A media sanitisation and disposal policy specifies:

choices.B: Methods for securely erasing or destroying storage media before disposal

questions.explanation: Media sanitisation policies specify secure erasure and destruction methods for storage media to prevent data recovery.

questions.stem: The MOST secure way to dispose of a drive containing classified data is:

choices.B: Physical destruction, degaussing, shredding, or incineration

questions.explanation: Physical destruction makes data recovery impossible. Degaussing, shredding, or incineration destroys the medium entirely.

choices.B: Visitors to show government ID at all entrances
choices.C: Uncleared visitors to be accompanied by an authorised employee at all times
choices.D: Visitors to receive temporary network access

questions.explanation: Visitor escort policy ensures uncleared visitors are accompanied throughout their visit, preventing unauthorised area access.

questions.stem: PCI DSS addresses physical security for:

choices.A: Environments storing, processing, or transmitting cardholder data

questions.explanation: PCI DSS includes physical security requirements for cardholder data environments, access controls, media handling, and visitor logs.

questions.stem: Which control most directly prevents exposure from a stolen laptop?
questions.explanation: Full-disk encryption makes data unreadable without the decryption key, physical possession of the stolen device does not expose the data.

choices.B: Shoulder surfing, viewing a screen from an angle in shared spaces

questions.explanation: A privacy filter narrows the viewing angle so only the direct user can see the screen, preventing shoulder surfing.

questions.stem: Colour-coded access badges in a data center provide:

choices.D: Visual identification enabling staff to spot unauthorised personnel

questions.explanation: Colour-coded badges let security staff immediately identify who is authorised in which areas, supporting physical access control.

choices.D: PACS logs accurately reflect actual entries with no unexplained discrepancies

questions.explanation: Physical access audits compare PACS logs against expected patterns and personnel records to detect anomalies.

questions.stem: When an employee is terminated, the IMMEDIATE physical security action is:

choices.A: Revoking all logical and physical access, accounts, VPN, and badge

questions.explanation: Immediate access revocation prevents the former employee from accessing systems or facilities after departure.

choices.C: Environmental design using natural surveillance, access control, and territorial reinforcement

questions.explanation: CPTED uses architectural design, clear sightlines, guided pathways, and ownership signalling, to inherently deter criminal activity.
